merged: **Mont Ventoux Observatory – Handover Summary** - **Instruments**: 60‑cm reflector (installed 2017) and 20‑cm outreach refractor. - **Observing time**: ~195 useful nights / yr (168 in 2024). No observations are permitted on outreach evenings. - **Data flow**: ≈400 GB per night (≈400 GB / month) transferred to Marseille in ~40 min. Raw frames are compressed after two years and never deleted (compression timing uncertain). - **Camera upgrade**: Main camera replaced March 2025, read‑noise reduced by 30 %; a full‑night offline firmware update is required. - **Past incidents**: * 2023 dome‑motor seizure bent the counter‑weight rod – repaired and a limit switch added. * Feb 2025 a 1.2 s timestamp offset (undetected) lost three weeks of photometry; all sessions are now GPS‑checked. - **Software policy**: Any acquisition‑software change must be tested on a dedicated night. - **Collaboration**: Spanish group awaiting review/evaluation of a shared scheduling tool; simultaneous‑transfer network capacity is unknown
